name: Conductor
tagline: Run a team of parallel AI coding agents on your Mac.
description: Conductor is a macOS app that runs multiple AI coding agents — Claude Code, Codex, and Cursor — in parallel, each in its own isolated git worktree. You dispatch tasks, watch each agent's progress in real time, then review and merge their changes without them stepping on each other. The app itself is free and runs on your own agent subscriptions; Conductor Cloud extends runs beyond your laptop.
insight: Built by Melty Labs (YC S24); it grew out of the team's earlier 'Melty' AI code editor into a manager for parallel agents.

modelSupport.notes: Runs your own Claude Code, Codex, or Cursor agents — bring those subscriptions/keys.

edge: A native Mac control plane that runs several coding agents at once, each sandboxed in its own git worktree so parallel work never collides.
pros: Runs many coding agents in parallel
Each agent isolated in a git worktree
Works with Claude Code, Codex, Cursor
App is free; bring your own agent plan
cons: Useful only with paid agent subscriptions
